name: FP8 KV cache
model_specific_reason: Qwen3-8B has eight KV heads across 36 layers and the canonical agent workload spends most decode steps at long context, making KV reads a first-order bandwidth term.
mechanism: FP8 halves KV capacity, read traffic, and write traffic relative to FP16, then the hardware group is re-sized around the lower capacity and bandwidth envelope.
